name: vt-prefix-at-ground

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: The attach prefix at a parser-ground point (D20; C4 decision 6): after hello, the grid's open and the output frames the core has fed, the core sends prefix and the VT answers prefix_ready — carrying the same request_id — followed by a kind-3 blob holding the dump. through_seq is the first parser-ground point after every frame received before the request, so it is a commit point (F3e) and the client's parser ends clean. This is the at-ground case; the not-at-ground wait case is vt-prefix-mid-sequence. The blob after the reply is a kind-3 message, not a control object, so it is not listed here; the dump's contents are graded by the U4 worker and the core's request by the U2 core (owed).
